description: Give each evolution variant its own chat tone in the backend chat handler's system prompt (packages/backend/src/handlers/chat.ts), threading the monster's `form` (resolved from the server-loaded record via the shared formOf helper) into buildSystemPrompt for both JA and EN. The 'base' / default form MUST keep today's prompt BYTE-IDENTICAL (both the JA 6-line prompt and the EN prompt), so legacy monsters and neutrally-raised monsters behave exactly as before and the existing affection-band lines still append after. Depends on FEAT-002 (MonsterForm, formOf). Backend bundles @ddm/shared, so this requires a Lambda redeploy — call that out in the handback.
steps: Review packages/backend/src/handlers/chat.ts buildSystemPrompt and the ChatContext type in packages/shared/src/game.ts. The chat context is resolved from the server-loaded monster via chooseChatContext; the form is available ONLY from the loaded server record (client chat requests do not carry form). Add `form: MonsterForm` to ChatContext in game.ts (defaulting to formOf(loaded) when a record exists, and 'base' when falling back to client fields), mirroring how `affection` was added to ChatContext in #42. Export MonsterForm is already done in FEAT-002.

In chat.ts buildSystemPrompt(context, lang): after the existing stage/affection lines are built, append a per-form tone line keyed by context.form. For form === 'base' append NOTHING (so the base prompt is byte-identical to today for both languages). For 'attack' append a brave/competitive/energetic fighter tone; for 'defense' append a calm/gentle/protective tone; for 'mischief' append a cheeky/playful/rascally tone. Provide BOTH a JA line (in the ja branch) and an EN line (in the en branch) for each of the three variants, matching the existing line style (short, imperative, consistent with the affection lines already there). Keep ordering stable: stage lines, then affection-band line (if any), then form line (if any) — or document the chosen order; just ensure 'base' adds nothing so neutral output is unchanged.

Verify the JA base-form prompt is byte-identical to the pre-change output: a monster with form 'base' (or legacy no-form, since formOf defaults to 'base') and neutral affection must yield exactly the original 6-line JA prompt. Keep an assertion or manual diff to confirm.

If there is an existing backend chat test (search packages/backend for chat prompt tests), extend it; otherwise add a small node:test for buildSystemPrompt-equivalent logic ONLY if buildSystemPrompt or a pure helper is exported/testable without network. Do NOT invoke Bedrock. If buildSystemPrompt is not currently exported and refactoring to export it is low-risk, extract the prompt-building into a pure exported helper and test it (base byte-identical, each variant appends its line, JA+EN). If extraction is risky, rely on the shared-side form coverage and document that the prompt wiring is verified by build + manual review.
Run `npm run build` (backend tsc/bundle) and `npm test`; confirm green.
acceptance_criteria: buildSystemPrompt produces a distinct tone line for each of 'attack'/'defense'/'mischief' in BOTH ja and en, and appends NOTHING for 'base'.
The JA base-form prompt (legacy/no-form or form 'base', neutral affection) is byte-identical to the pre-#38 prompt; the EN base prompt is unchanged too.
ChatContext carries the resolved form (formOf of the loaded record, 'base' on client fallback).
`npm run build` and `npm test` pass; no new runtime dependency.
findings:
DONE. Commit fbdc0b0 on feat/evolution-branching.

FILES CHANGED (3):
- packages/shared/src/game.ts: added `form: MonsterForm` to the ChatContext interface and set it in chooseChatContext (formOf(loaded) when a server record exists, FORM_DEFAULT ('base') on client fallback). MonsterForm/formOf/FORM_DEFAULT already existed from FEAT-002, so no new imports were needed (game.ts already imports MonsterForm and defines formOf/FORM_DEFAULT).
- packages/backend/src/handlers/chat.ts: in buildSystemPrompt, appended a per-form tone line keyed by context.form AFTER the existing stage lines and the warm/cold affection-band push, in BOTH the en and ja branches. Order is: stage lines -> affection-band line (if any) -> form line (if any). No new imports (context.form is read off the existing ChatContext param).
- packages/shared/src/__tests__/review-fixes.test.ts: extended the existing chooseChatContext tests to assert form threading.

EXACT TONE LINES ADDED PER VARIANT:
- attack  EN: "You evolved into an attack type, so speak in a brave, competitive, energetic fighter's tone."
           JA: "攻撃タイプに進化したので、勇敢で負けず嫌い、元気いっぱいの戦士のような口調で話してください。"
- defense EN: "You evolved into a defense type, so speak in a calm, gentle, protective tone."
           JA: "防御タイプに進化したので、落ち着いて優しく、飼い主を守ろうとする頼もしい口調で話してください。"
- mischief EN: "You evolved into a mischief type, so speak in a cheeky, playful, rascally tone."
           JA: "やんちゃタイプに進化したので、生意気で遊び好き、いたずらっぽい口調で話してください。"
- base: appends NOTHING in both languages.

BYTE-IDENTICAL CONFIRMATION: `git diff HEAD` on chat.ts shows the ONLY changes are additive `if (context.form === ...)` blocks (plus a comment) inserted after the existing `lines` arrays and the warm/cold pushes. The 6-line JA base `lines` array, the EN `lines` array, and the warm/cold pushes are untouched. For form 'base' (and legacy no-form, which formOf maps to 'base') none of the new branches run, so the neutral JA prompt and the EN prompt are byte-identical to pre-#38.

TESTS: No backend test infrastructure exists (packages/backend has no test script and no test runner; root `npm test` runs only the @ddm/shared suite). buildSystemPrompt is not exported. Per the FEAT-003 spec option, extracting it was judged not worth adding a new test harness to the backend; instead the form wiring is covered shared-side via chooseChatContext tests + build + the byte-identical diff review. Added/extended 3 shared tests in review-fixes.test.ts: (1) server record -> ctx.form from loaded record (form 'attack'); (2) client fallback -> ctx.form 'base'; (3) legacy no-form record -> ctx.form 'base' via formOf default. No Bedrock invoked in any test.

BUILD/TEST RESULTS: `npm run build` (shared+backend tsc, frontend vite, infra) PASS. `npm test` PASS: 117 shared tests (was 116 after FEAT-002; +1 net). No new runtime dependency.

DEPLOY NOTE: The backend Lambda bundles @ddm/shared, and both chat.ts and the bundled shared (ChatContext/chooseChatContext) changed, so the backend Lambda MUST be redeployed for the per-form tone to take effect in production.
